pairsWith.noteUz: Grammatika mashqlari: present simple / present continuous coursebook 10-bet 21-26-mashqlarga, 'am/is/are/do' savollari coursebook 11-bet 29-mashqqa mos keladi.

scanNote:
WORKBOOK 1-UNITNING IKKINChI BETI (5-bet). Yuqorida o'ngda 'People around the World' va to'q sariq '1'.

CHAP USTUN - 'Grammar' (to'q sariq doira belgisi):
5) 'Fill in the missing words.' 1 ........ are you from? 2 ........ old is she? 3 ........ does he look like? 4 ........ colour eyes have you got? 5 ........ tall is he? 6 ........ do you live?
6) 'Study the sentences below and say whether the 's is is or has as in the example.' 1 Jill's got a good figure. ...has... 2 Tim's short and fat. 3 Greg's a handsome man. 4 Nora's got long red hair. 5 Paul's got broad shoulders. 6 Ken's bald. 7 Ray's got light blue eyes. 8 Jenny's a pretty girl.
7) 'Use the words in the list to complete the dialogue below.' Qiya: 'am, is, are, do'. A: Hello? B: Hello, Tracy. This 1) ...... Tom. What 2) ...... you doing? A: Hi, Tom. I 3) ...... studying for an exam. How 4) ...... you? B: Oh, I 5) ...... fine. I want to ask you a question. A: Sure. B: 6) ...... you know anyone who repairs cars? A: Of course I 7) ......! My cousin Jeff 8) ...... a mechanic. He loves repairing cars - especially old ones like yours!
8) 'Write the third person singular.' 1 I catch - she ......, 2 I meet - she, 3 I listen - she, 4 I ride - she, 5 I wash - she, 6 I plant - she, 7 I sit - she, 8 I relax - she, 9 I need - she, 10 I visit - she.

O'NG USTUN:
9) 'Put the verbs in brackets into the correct tense.' John: Where 1) ...do you come from... (you/come from), Tina? Tina: I 2) ...... (come from) Paris. John: 3) ...... (you/live) near the city centre? Tina: Yes, I 4) ...... (do). I 5) ...... (live) in a small flat with my sister, Denise. John: 6) ...... (you/go) to university? Tina: No, I 7) ...... (not/do). I 8) ...... (work) for a law firm. I 9) ...... (be) a lawyer. John: 10) ...... (you/like) it there? Tina: Yes, very much.
10) 'Put the verbs in brackets into the present simple or the present continuous.' SURAT: Venetsiyadagi Rialto ko'prigi (kanal ustidagi ravoqli tosh ko'prik). XAT (pushti qog'oz): '6th August, ... Dear Anne, I 1) ...... (write) to you from Italy. I 2) ...... (be) on holiday with some friends. We 3) ...... (stay) at a beautiful hotel in Venice. The sun usually 4) ...... (shine) brightly all day at this time of year, but it 5) ...... (rain) at the moment. My friends and I 6) ...... (be) never bored. There are so many things to do here and we 7) ...... (try) hard not to miss anything. We 8) ...... (have) a snack right now, and we 9) ...... (wait) for the rain to stop. Everyone 10) ...... (have) a great time. See you next week. Best wishes, Jennifer'

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '5'.

exercises.explanationUz:
SO'ROQ SO'ZLARI - ODAM HAQIDA
  (coursebook 11-bet 29-mashq).

  Where ... from?    = qayerdan?
  How old ...?       = necha yosh?
  What ... look like? = qanday
    ko'rinadi? (TAShQI QIYOFA)
  What colour ...?   = qanday rang?
  How tall ...?      = bo'yi qancha?
  Where ... live?    = qayerda
    yashaydi?


⚠ 'WHAT DOES HE LOOK LIKE?':

  = Tashqi qiyofasi qanday?
  Javob: 'He is tall, with dark hair.'

  ⚠ 'What is he LIKE?' = Xarakteri
  qanday? (4-bet). ADAShTIRMANG!


⚠ 'HOW + SIFAT':

  How old = yoshi
  How tall = bo'yi
  ⚠ Javob: 'He's 1.80 m tall.'


⚠ 'WHAT COLOUR EYES':

  'What colour' + OT (eyes/hair).
  ⚠ 'What colour ARE his eyes?' ham
  mumkin.

items.whyUz:
⚠ 'Where ... from?' - kelib chiqish.
Javob: 'I'm from Spain.'

⚠ 'What does he look like?' = tashqi qiyofasi qanday?
⚠ 'What is he like?' = xarakteri.

exercises.instructionEn: Study the sentences below and say whether the 's is is or has as in the example. Example: Jill's got a good figure. - has
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi gaplarni o'rganing va 's - is yoki has ekanini ayting, namunadagidek. Namuna: Jill's got a good figure. - has
exercises.explanationUz:
'S = IS yoki HAS?

  ⚠ QOIDA JUDA ODDIY:
  's + GOT  → HAS ('s got = has got)
  's + boshqa (sifat/ot) → IS

  Jill's got ...   → HAS got
  Tim's short      → IS short
  Greg's a man     → IS a man


⚠ 'HAS GOT' = EGALIK:

  'has got' = bor (ega).
  She's got long hair = Uning uzun
  sochi bor.


⚠ 'IS' = BO'LMOQ:

  He's bald = U kal.
  She's a pretty girl = U chiroyli
  qiz.


⚠ TAShQI QIYOFA SO'ZLARI:

  a good figure = kelishgan qomat
  broad shoulders = keng yelka
  bald = kal
  light blue eyes = och ko'k ko'zlar
  ⚠ 'fat' - qo'pol so'z, odob bilan
  'overweight'.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the words in the list to complete the dialogue below: am, is, are, do.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdagi so'zlar bilan dialogni to'ldiring: am, is, are, do.
exercises.explanationUz:
AM / IS / ARE / DO - TELEFON
  SUHBATI.

  ⚠ 'This IS Tom' - telefonda o'zini
  tanishtirish ('I am Tom' EMAS!).

  ⚠ 'What ARE you doing?' - present
  continuous (hozir).
  ⚠ 'I AM studying' - continuous.
  ⚠ 'How ARE you?' / 'I AM fine.'
  ⚠ 'DO you know ...?' - present
  simple so'roq.
  ⚠ 'Of course I DO!' - qisqa javob.
  ⚠ 'Jeff IS a mechanic' - kasb.


⚠ 'ANYONE WHO REPAIRS CARS':

  'anyone' = biror kim
  'who repairs' = ... ta'mirlaydigan
  ⚠ 'who' dan keyin 3-shaxs -S.


⚠ 'TO LOVE + V-ING':

  'He loves repairing cars'.


⚠ 'ONES LIKE YOURS':

  'ones' = cars (takrorlamaslik
  uchun); 'yours' = seniki.

lines.uz: Salom, Treysi. Bu Tom. Nima qilyapsan?
lines.whyUz:
⚠ 'This IS Tom' - telefonda tanishtirish.
⚠ 'What ARE you doing?' - continuous.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Hi, Tom. I 3) ___ studying for an exam. How 4) ___ you?
lines.uz: Salom, Tom. Imtihonga tayyorlanyapman. Ishlaring qalay?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Oh, I 5) ___ fine. I want to ask you a question.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: 6) ___ you know anyone who repairs cars?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Of course I 7) ___! My cousin Jeff 8) ___ a mechanic. He loves repairing cars - especially old ones like yours!
lines.uz: Albatta bilaman! Amakivachcham Jeff mexanik. U mashina ta'mirlashni yaxshi ko'radi - ayniqsa seniki kabi eskilarini!
lines.whyUz:
⚠ 'Of course I DO' - qisqa javob.
⚠ 'Jeff IS a mechanic' - kasb.

exercises.explanationUz:
3-ShAXS BIRLIK (he/she/it) -
  PRESENT SIMPLE.

  ⚠ QOIDA (coursebook 10-bet):
  1) ko'pchilik fe'l: + S
     meet → meets, ride → rides
  2) -ch, -sh, -s, -x, -o: + ES
     catch → catchES, wash → washES,
     relax → relaxES
  3) undosh + y: y → IES
     study → studies
  4) unli + y: + S
     play → plays


⚠ TALAFFUZ:

  /s/  - jarangsizdan keyin: meets,
         sits, visits
  /z/  - jaranglidan keyin: rides,
         listens, plants? (/ts/)
  /ɪz/ - -es (ch/sh/x): catches,
         washes, relaxes


⚠ 'NEED' → 'NEEDS' (oddiy +s).

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the correct tense.
exercises.explanationUz:
PRESENT SIMPLE - DOIMIY HOLATLAR.

  ⚠ Butun dialog PRESENT SIMPLE:
  qayerdan, qayerda yashaydi, qayerda
  ishlaydi - doimiy faktlar.


⚠ SO'ROQ (you bilan):

  Do you come from ...?
  Do you live ...?
  Do you go ...?
  Do you like ...?
  ⚠ 'Do' + ega + fe'l (oddiy).


⚠ QISQA JAVOB:

  Yes, I do. / No, I don't.


⚠ 'TO WORK FOR A LAW FIRM':

  'work FOR' = ... da ishlamoq
  (ish beruvchi).
  'a law firm' = yuridik firma
  'a lawyer' = advokat, yurist.


⚠ 'THE CITY CENTRE':

  Brit. 'centre' / AQSh 'center'.


⚠ 'A FLAT':

  Brit. = kvartira (AQSh 'apartment').

lines.speaker: John
lines.whyUz: ⚠ NAMUNA. Present simple so'roq: 'do you come from'.

lines.speaker: Tina
lines.en: Yes, I 4) ___ (do). I 5) ___ (live) in a small flat with my sister, Denise.
lines.uz: Ha. Singlim Deniz bilan kichik kvartirada yashayman.

lines.speaker: Tina
lines.en: No, I 7) ___ (not/do). I 8) ___ (work) for a law firm. I 9) ___ (be) a lawyer.
lines.uz: Yo'q. Men yuridik firmada ishlayman. Men advokatman.
lines.whyUz:
⚠ 'No, I don't.'
⚠ 'work' - doimiy ish.
⚠ 'I am a lawyer' - kasb.

lines.speaker: John
lines.whyUz:
⚠ So'roq: 'Do you like'.
⚠ 'like' - holat fe'li, continuous'da ishlatilmaydi.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the present simple or the present continuous. (Letter from Jennifer to Anne, 6th August, Venice.)
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni present simple yoki present continuous shakliga qo'ying. (Jenniferning Annga xati, 6-avgust, Venetsiya.)
exercises.explanationUz:
PRESENT SIMPLE yoki CONTINUOUS?
  (coursebook 10-bet qoidasi)

  SIMPLE - doimiy, odatiy:
    'usually', 'never', faktlar
  CONTINUOUS - hozir, vaqtincha:
    'at the moment', 'right now',
    ta'tildagi vaqtinchalik holat


XATDAGI KALIT SO'ZLAR:

  1 am writing - hozir yozyapti
  2 am - holat fe'li ('be')
  3 are staying - VAQTINChA turibdi
  4 USUALLY shines - odatiy
  5 is raining AT THE MOMENT
  6 are never bored - 'be' + never
  7 are trying - hozir harakat
  8 are having RIGHT NOW
  9 are waiting - hozir
  10 is having - hozir (Everyone = 3-
     shaxs birlik!)


⚠ 'TO STAY' - TA'TILDA:

  'We are staying at a hotel' -
  vaqtincha → CONTINUOUS.
  ⚠ 'live' = doimiy, 'stay' =
  vaqtincha.


⚠ 'EVERYONE' = BIRLIK:

  'Everyone IS having' ('are' EMAS).


⚠ 'TO HAVE A SNACK':

  'have' = yemoq ma'nosida →
  continuous bo'la oladi:
  'we are having a snack'.
  ⚠ 'have' = egalik → continuous
  BO'LMAYDI.


⚠ 'TO BE BORED':

  = zerikmoq. 'never bored' =
  hech qachon zerikmaydi.


⚠ RIALTO KO'PRIGI:

  Suratdagi ko'prik - Venetsiyadagi
  Rialto (1591), Katta kanal ustida.

items.textEn: Dear Anne, I ___ (write) to you from Italy.
I ___ (be) on holiday with some friends.
We ___ (stay) at a beautiful hotel in Venice.
The sun usually ___ (shine) brightly all day at this time of year,
My friends and I ___ (be) never bored.
There are so many things to do here and we ___ (try) hard not to miss anything.

items.whyUz:
⚠ 'RIGHT NOW' → CONTINUOUS.
⚠ 'have a snack' = yemoq → continuous mumkin.

items.textEn: and we ___ (wait) for the rain to stop.
Everyone ___ (have) a great time. See you next week. Best wishes, Jennifer

patterns.exampleEn: What does he look like? - He's tall, with dark hair.
patterns.exampleUz: U qanday ko'rinadi? - U baland bo'yli, qora sochli.

patterns.formula: Do you + FE'L ...? - Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
patterns.exampleEn: Do you live near the city centre? - Yes, I do.
patterns.explanationUz: ⚠ Present simple so'roq va qisqa javob.

patterns.formula: X usually + V-s, but X is + V-ing at the moment.
patterns.exampleEn: The sun usually shines, but it is raining at the moment.
patterns.exampleUz: Odatda quyosh porlaydi, lekin hozir yomg'ir yog'yapti.
